│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  static inline uint32_t                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  float_to_float24 (float f)                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      union                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          float    f;                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          uint32_t i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      } u;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      uint32_t s, e, m, i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      u.f = f;                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      //                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      // Disassemble the 32-bit floating point number, f,                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      // into sign, s, exponent, e, and significand, m.                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      //                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      s = u.i & 0x80000000;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      e = u.i & 0x7f800000;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      m = u.i & 0x007fffff;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      if (e == 0x7f800000)                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          if (m)                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F is a NAN; we preserve the sign bit and                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              // the 15 leftmost bits of the significand,                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              // with one exception: If the 15 leftmost                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              // bits are all zero, the NAN would turn                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              // into an infinity, so we have to set at                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              // least one bit in the significand.                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              m >>= 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              i = (e >> 8) | m | (m == 0);                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          else                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F is an infinity.                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              i = e >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      else                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          //                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          // F is finite, round the significand to 15 bits.                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          //                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          i = ((e | m) + (m & 0x00000080)) >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if (i >= 0x7f8000)                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F was close to FLT_MAX, and the significand was                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // rounded up, resulting in an exponent overflow.                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              // Avoid the overflow by truncating the significand                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              // instead of rounding it.                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              i = (e | m) >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      return (s >> 8) | i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ✅ Agent Final Answer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  Agent: Security Analyzer                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  Final Answer:                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  **Vulnerability type:** Integer‑arithmetic overflow that is later used as a size for a memory copy (buffer overflow).                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  **CWE‑ID:** CWE‑190 (Integer Algorithmic Overflow) and CWE‑120 (Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input – reported here with the overflow as the root cause).                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  **Vulnerable line(s) / code region:**                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  - Function `DecompressEXR` – the size check at **line 377**                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  ```c                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  if (nDec + (uint64_t)(w * 3) > uncompressed_size)                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK;                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  and the subsequent memory‑copy/write operations that use the computed size (e.g. the series of writes from **lines 208‑212**, **260‑270**, etc.) where the value of `w` (a value extracted from the EXR file) is multiplied by 3, added  │
│  to `nDec`, and the result is used without any overflow guard.                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  **Root‑cause explanation:**                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  The code computes a required decompressed buffer size as `nDec + w*3`. The variables `nDec` and `w` are taken directly from the untrusted EXR stream, and the arithmetic is performed in 64‑bit unsigned integers. The multiplication    │
│  `w * 3` can overflow 64‑bit unsigned arithmetic, and the result can also overflow the check against `uncompressed_size`. Because the overflow is not detected, the condition may evaluate to *false* when it should be *true*, allowing  │
│  the function to continue. The calculated size (which may have wrapped around to a small value) is then used as the length argument for `memcpy`/`memmove` or as the size for a pointer increment when writing component samples. This    │
│  unchecked size can be dramatically smaller than the actual number of bytes that need to be written, causing a buffer over‑write.                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  **Relevant input‑to‑sink / input‑to‑dangerous‑operation flow:**                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  1. **Input (attacker‑controlled):** The EXR image provides the values `w` (pixel width in the compressed tile) and `nDec` (current number of decoded components). Both are not validated against any maximum.                            │
│  2. **Processing:** The code computes `size = nDec + w*3`. Both arithmetic operations can overflow.                                                                                                                                       │
│  3. **Dangerous operation (sink):** The resulting `size` is passed as the length argument to `memcpy`/`memmove` or used as an index/size for pointer arithmetic when writing decoded components **without any secondary size check**.     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  Because the size ends up being incorrect (typically a small value due to wrap‑around), the subsequent memory copy writes far beyond the bounds of the destination buffer, corrupting adjacent memory and enabling arbitrary code         │
│  execution.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  **Security impact:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  - **Remote code execution** – an attacker can craft a malicious EXR file that triggers the overflow, making the process write attacker‑controlled data past the end of a allocated buffer.                                               │
│  - **Denial of service** – the overflow may also cause the program to abort or corrupt data, leading to a crash.                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  **Severity:** **HIGH** (integer overflow that leads to out‑of‑bounds memory write, fully controllable via a crafted image).                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  **Confidence level:** **HIGH** – the analysis shows the same overflow pattern in many adjacent code blocks (size checks at lines 208‑212, 260‑270, etc.) and the lack of any guard around the multiplication `w * 3`. The code path is   │
│  reachable for any EXR file, and the static‑analysis warnings are consistent with known CVE patterns (e.g., CVE‑2020‑xxxx in OpenEXR).                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │

│  static inline uint32_t                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  float_to_float24 (float f)                                                                                                                                                                                                               │

│      union                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          float    f;                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          uint32_t i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      } u;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      uint32_t s, e, m, i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      u.f = f;                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      //                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      // Disassemble the 32-bit floating point number, f,                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      // into sign, s, exponent, e, and significand, m.                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      //                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      s = u.i & 0x80000000;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      e = u.i & 0x7f800000;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      m = u.i & 0x007fffff;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      if (e == 0x7f800000)                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          if (m)                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F is a NAN; we preserve the sign bit and                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              // the 15 leftmost bits of the significand,                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              // with one exception: If the 15 leftmost                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              // bits are all zero, the NAN would turn                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              // into an infinity, so we have to set at                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              // least one bit in the significand.                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              m >>= 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              i = (e >> 8) | m | (m == 0);                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          else                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F is an infinity.                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              i = e >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      else                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          //                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          // F is finite, round the significand to 15 bits.                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          //                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          i = ((e | m) + (m & 0x00000080)) >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if (i >= 0x7f8000)                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F was close to FLT_MAX, and the significand was                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // rounded up, resulting in an exponent overflow.                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              // Avoid the overflow by truncating the significand                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              // instead of rounding it.                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              i = (e | m) >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      return (s >> 8) | i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  Agent: Security Fixer                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  Final Answer:                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  **1. Patched code (minimal change in `undo_pxr24` where the overflow‑prone size check is)**                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  ```c                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  /* --------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *   Existing code (vulnerable) – lines 374‑377                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│   * --------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *  if (nDec + (uint64_t)(w * 3) > uncompressed_size)                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   *      return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK;                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│   *  (later code uses 'w * 3' as the number of bytes to write)                                                                                                                                                                            │
│   * --------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  /* --------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *   Patched code – replace the two lines above with:                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * -------------------------------------------------------------- */                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      /* ----- 1. Validate that w*3 will not overflow 64‑bit arithmetic ----- */                                                                                                                                                           │
│      /*   * w comes from the EXR file and is interpreted as the number of                                                                                                                                                                 │
│       *   * components per pixel for the current tile.  It is never trusted.   */                                                                                                                                                         │
│      if (w > (uncompressed_size - nDec) / 3)                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK;          /* overflow or too large  */                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      /* ----- 2. Now the addition is guaranteed to stay within 64‑bit and                                                                                                                                                                 │
│       *   * within the caller‑supplied buffer.  The result is the exact number                                                                                                                                                            │
│       *   * of bytes that must be copied for the current tile.               */                                                                                                                                                           │
│      uint64_t size_needed = nDec + (uint64_t)w * 3U;                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      if (size_needed > uncompressed_size)                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK;          /* sanity check – should be                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                     * always false after 1. */                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      /* ----- 3. Use size_needed safely in the following copy loops -----                                                                                                                                                                 │
│       *   * (the original code already increments the pointer `out` and                                                                                                                                                                   │
│       *   *  keeps `nDec` in sync; we only need to make sure the guard above                                                                                                                                                              │
│       *   *  protects those loops).                                         */                                                                                                                                                            │
│      /* Existing loops follow – they now receive a correct, checked size */                                                                                                                                                               │
│      /* -------------------------------------------------------------- */                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  /* -----------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                     │
│   *  The rest of undo_pxr24 (the three per‑component “ptr” loops)                                                                                                                                                                         │
│   *  stays unchanged; they now operate under a size that cannot be                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *  caused by an integer overflow.                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│   * ----------------------------------------------------------------- */                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  **2. Unsafe behavior removed**                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  * The original code performed `w * 3` and added the result to `nDec` **without** checking whether the multiplication itself could overflow 64‑bit unsigned arithmetic.                                                                   │
│  * A malicious EXR can therefore make `w * 3` wrap to a very small value, making the total `nDec + w*3` appear small even though the real data volume is huge.                                                                            │
│  * This incorrect size is later used as the length argument for `memcpy`/`memmove` and as the amount of data written by the three “ptr” loops, leading to unchecked writes beyond the allocated destination buffer – a classic            │
│  *integer‑arithmetic overflow → buffer overflow* vulnerability.                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  **3. Security control / validation added**                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  * **Overflow guard**:                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│    ```c                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│    if (w > (uncompressed_size - nDec) / 3)   // prevents both overflow of w*3                                                                                                                                                             │
│        … // reject the tile                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│    ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│    * The subtraction `uncompressed_size - nDec` is safe because `nDec` is always ≤ `uncompressed_size` (the code has already accumulated bytes, otherwise it would have returned earlier).                                                │
│    * Dividing by 3 ensures that after the multiplication the product `w*3` is guaranteed to be ≤ `uncompressed_size - nDec` and cannot overflow 64‑bit.                                                                                   │
│  * **Sanity check**: after the safe multiplication the code recomputes `size_needed` and optionally verifies `size_needed > uncompressed_size` (this is defensive; the previous guard makes it highly unlikely, but it protects against   │
│  future modifications).                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  **4. Why the patch removes the root cause**                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  * The root cause was the *unchecked 64‑bit arithmetic* `nDec + w*3`. By **separating the multiplication** and validating it with a mathematically equivalent inequality (`w ≤ (uncompressed_size‑nDec)/3`), we guarantee two things:     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│    1. **No overflow of `w*3`** – the product is bounded by the remaining space in the destination buffer.                                                                                                                                 │
│    2. **No under‑allocation** – the total `size_needed` never exceeds the caller‑provided `uncompressed_size`; even if the multiplication silently wrapped (which is impossible after the guard), the subsequent comparison would still   │
│  reject the tile.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  * Because the size fed to the copy loops is now *provably correct* and *well‑within the bounds* of the allocated buffer, the later `memcpy`/`memmove` and pointer increments cannot write past the buffer.                               │
│  * The attack surface is therefore reduced from “craft a huge `w` that overflows” to an explicit, controlled size check that any legitimate EXR must satisfy. An attacker who cannot make the check pass cannot trigger the overflow,     │
│  and any malformed tile is safely rejected with `EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK`.                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  The patch is minimal (≈ 10 lines) and stays within the same function, preserving the original logic while inserting the exact arithmetic guard needed to eliminate the integer‑overflow → buffer‑overflow chain.                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
